parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic, typically circular or polygonal in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid soap or lotion through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head includes the nozzle and upper housing of the pump, made of plastic and connected to the pressing lid.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the outside when the lid is pressed, ensuring controlled flow.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but is connected to the internal pump mechanism that moves slightly during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, typically transparent or translucent, used to hold the liquid.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the soap or lotion and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and serves as the main reservoir.
